recognize_zh: CD5 染色中，片狀小型淋巴球幾乎全部呈膜狀陽性，但強度中等；箭頭指的少數細胞呈較強、較清楚的環狀膜染色（推測為 T 細胞）。瀰漫浸潤的 B 細胞表現 CD5（強度弱於 T 細胞），符合 CLL。
features: Diffuse sheets of small round lymphoid cells with membranous CD5 staining
Moderate, relatively uniform staining intensity in the infiltrating cells
Scattered cells with crisper, stronger ring-like membranous staining (arrows), likely T cells
Scant interstitial spaces with CD5-negative stromal cells
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD5 shows diffuse membranous positivity in sheets of small lymphoid cells. The staining intensity in the infiltrating cells is moderate, whereas scattered cells (arrows) show stronger, well-defined ring-like membranous staining consistent with background T cells. Because T cells are normally CD5-positive, coexpression with PAX5 or CD20 on the same population is required to confirm aberrant CD5 expression by B cells. Findings are consistent with a CD5-positive small B-cell lymphoproliferative disorder, compatible with chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: MCL is also CD5-positive but is CD23-negative and cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.
A T-cell process would be CD3-positive and PAX5/CD20-negative, which distinguishes it from CD5-positive B cells.
Rare CD5-positive MZL is LEF1-negative and CD23-negative, with marginal zone or monocytoid morphology.
